import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(r'C:\Users\27933\.codex\worktrees\architecture-convergence-recovered\ClawX')
OUT = Path(__file__).parent / 'candidate'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
SPEC = 'harness/specs/tasks/architecture-authority-declaration-convergence.md'
PNPM = 'C:/Users/27933/AppData/Local/pnpm/.tools/pnpm/11.2.2/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
env = {**os.environ, 'TEMP': 'D:/tmp', 'TMP': 'D:/tmp', 'TMPDIR': 'D:/tmp', 'GOMAXPROCS': '4', 'UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE': '2', 'pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run': 'warn'}
assert not git('status', '--porcelain')
candidate = {'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'), 'dirty': False}
tests = ['semantic-authority-consistency', 'architecture-authority-convergence', 'component-authority-manifest', 'component-disposition-catalog', 'model-capability-profile', 'default-config-matrix', 'component-graduation-report', 'memory-control-plane', 'capability-claims']
commands = [
    ('tests', ['node', 'node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs', 'run', *['tests/unit/' + t + '.test.ts' for t in tests], '--maxWorkers=1', '--reporter=verbose', '--reporter=json', '--outputFile.json=' + str(OUT / 'tests.json')]),
    ('types', ['node', PNPM, 'run', 'typecheck']),
    ('authority', ['node', 'scripts/check-semantic-authority.mjs', '--report', str(OUT / 'authority.json'), '--actor', 'codex-architecture-convergence']),
    ('contract', ['node', 'scripts/contract-check.mjs']),
    ('evidence', ['node', 'scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs']),
    ('retention', ['node', 'scripts/check-repository-artifacts.mjs']),
    ('lint', ['node', 'node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js', 'shared/component-authority-manifest.ts', 'shared/dcs/component-disposition-catalog.ts', 'tests/unit/architecture-authority-convergence.test.ts', 'tests/unit/semantic-authority-consistency.test.ts', '--max-warnings', '0']),
    ('context', ['node', 'harness/src/cli.mjs', 'context', '--spec', SPEC]),
    ('validate', ['node', 'harness/src/cli.mjs', 'validate', '--spec', SPEC]),
    ('dry-run', ['node', 'harness/src/cli.mjs', 'run', '--spec', SPEC, '--dry-run']),
    ('diff', ['git', 'diff', '--check', '3a362590d6b54e1e2083ec626d4cb9553905a3ad']),
]
results=[]
for name, argv in commands:
    start=time.monotonic()
    before=git('status','--porcelain')
    assert not before
    with (OUT/(name+'.stdout.txt')).open('wb') as stdout, (OUT/(name+'.stderr.txt')).open('wb') as stderr:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
        while proc.poll() is None:
            try: proc.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: print(json.dumps({'running':name,'pid':proc.pid,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start)}),flush=True)
    result={'id':name,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(ROOT),'candidate':candidate,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'durationSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'finishedAt':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'afterDirty':bool(git('status','--porcelain'))}
    for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
        raw=(OUT/(name+'.'+stream+'.txt')).read_bytes()
        result[stream]={'path':str(OUT/(name+'.'+stream+'.txt')),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'text':raw.decode('utf-8')}
    results.append(result)
    (OUT/'gates.json').write_text(json.dumps({'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-convergence','candidate':candidate,'gates':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'id':name,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'seconds':result['durationSeconds'],'afterDirty':result['afterDirty']}),flush=True)
    assert not result['afterDirty']
raise SystemExit(int(any(r['exitCode'] for r in results)))

gaps = json.loads((ROOT / 'scripts/check-semantic-authority-adjudication.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['gaps']
assert len(mapping) == len(gaps) == 35
rows = []
for gap in gaps:
    category, path, anchor, rationale = mapping[gap['target']]
    anchors = {
        'task-loop': 'await (deps.ensureTaskLedgerRoot ?? ensureLongTaskLedgerRoot)',
        'capability.execution-schema': 'export function normalizeProviderToolSchemas',
        'memory.native-file': 'export function hybridSearchFacts',
        'provider.media': 'export async function runCapability',
        'provider.model-identity': 'export function resolveAllowedModelRef',
        'runtime.config': 'export async function writeConfigFile',
        'skill.manifest': 'export type OpenClawSkillMetadata',
        'dangerous-approvals': 'export function verifyPermissionEffectAtFinalCheckpoint',
        'file-writes': 'export function createWriteToolDefinition',
        'session-restore-replay': 'export function deriveRecoveryRecommendations',
        'compaction': 'export default function compactionSafeguardExtension',
        'transcript': '? redactTranscriptMessage(message, params.config)',
        'knowledge.candidate': 'KNOWLEDGE_LIFECYCLE_STAGES',
    }
    anchor = anchors.get(gap['target'], anchor)
    raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    assert anchor in text, (path, anchor)
    line = text[:text.index(anchor)].count('\n') + 1
    rows.append({'ruling': gap['id'], 'class': gap['class'], 'target': gap['target'], 'category': category,
        'source': path, 'anchor': anchor, 'line': line, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest(),
        'rationale': rationale, 'registrationResolved': False})
